Graduate Application Options

Admissions
Graduate Admissions
Application Options
Apply for admission to the Graduate School at UNCW. Choose between Regular Term Instruction (RTI) or one of our Online or Main Campus Accelerated Programs.
Need help with applying? Check out our Getting Started page!
Choose Your Program Type
Regular Term Instruction (RTI)
We have a large selection of Regular Term Instruction (RTI) graduate programs! You can choose from face-to-face or online options. These programs are pursued independently from OAP Programs.
RTI Program Options
Doctoral
Master's Degree
Certificate
Add-on-Licensure
Non-Degree
Senior Citizen Audit
Our Program List & Key Dates page has a full list of programs with links to application details, deadlines, and requirement information.
Apply For RTI
Online & Main Campus Accelerated Programs
These accelerated programs are taken one at a time and are pursued independently from any other program.
Accelerated Program Options
Business Foundations PB Cert.*
Human Resource Management PB Cert.*
M.A. Integrated Marketing Communication*
M.B.A. Business Administration*
M.H.A. Healthcare Administration*
M.S. Business Analytics **
M.S. Finance & Investment Management **
M.S. Supply Chain Management*
M.S.N. Nurse Educator*
* Offered online
** Offered online and main campus
APPLY FOR Accelerated Programs
Already Started an Application? Continue It Here!
Admission Application Policies
$75 USD application fee (payable by MasterCard, Visa or Discover)
Application fees are non-refundable and non-transferable and due upon submission
Recommendations may be reused from a submitted application (with paid application fee) for up to one academic year.
Refer to the Key Dates Page prior to submission
Graduate Degrees and Programs
We offer a wide variety of programs to meet your needs. Explore our doctoral, master, certificate, add-on licensure and non-degree programs to find the right fit for you.
